name: 동빛전갈
appearance: Rust-copper scorpion with narrow body, compact pincers and one clearly arched segmented tail, pale stone joint accents.

motions.stand: Facing left, compact pincers open and close in turn, tail stinger tilts forward and back along the single arched segmented tail, small legs flex, return to original ready pose.
motions.move: Facing left, quick coordinated alternating leg cycle in place, compact pincers held ahead and single arched segmented tail counterbalances with a small articulated sway. No extra tails.
motions.attack1: Facing left, draw the single segmented tail back and up in a clear wind-up, then whip the stinger in a forward downward arc over the body toward left, stop at a clear low strike and retract the tail to the original arch. Pincers stay compact.
motions.hit1: Facing left, both pincers shield the head and front legs bend from impact, single tail curls close over the back defensively, recover to ready arch.
motions.die1: Facing left, narrow body sinks and legs fold under, pincers relax and the single segmented tail unarches onto the ground behind the body, finish motionless, no dismemberment.
